QuestInfo.name: Nabbing the Foodnapper
QuestInfo.0: While you were enjoying a savory corn dog, a thief made off with the ingredients for your dinner. Ask #bGusto#k if he saw which way the culprit went.
QuestInfo.1: It seems like the thief set off in the direction of a place swarming with #o2400303#s. You should catch him and give him a scolding.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated all the Hoodlums and caught the petty thief. It turns out he was just a kid.

0.msg: Now you're in for it. You picked the wrong person to rob, buddy!

default.0: It looked like he went off in the direction of those Hoodlums.\r\n
